model_definition.name: Barodesy sand2015 fixed-frame interior v0.3 research draft
model_definition.description: Non-admitted2015 Eq31 sand research selection. Compression-positive orthonormal Mandel stress and stretching; W=0. Nonzero stress only; exact zero-loading continuous rate extension selected for research, no unique zero-loading Frechet derivative claimed. Seven physical states. Defaults separately attributed2019 illustrative calibration, not exact2015 validation. Conservative numerical interior and parameter envelope, not complete physical applicability. c4 is a physical stress parameter and also a provisional solver normalization; this does not establish a universal tolerance scale. V2 separates ideal source reference from operational binary64 support and retains exact Fraction volumetric oracle; no source equation change.
